title: Coordinate-normalized prime-power orientations satisfy Rees normalization
statement: For a finite purity setting P with bottom coefficient extension P.extension=⊥, Noetherian X,Y, a separated quasi-compact compactifiable pure-d-smooth map f:X→Y and a separated finite-type structure map aY:Y→Spec(P.field.k), let G be its actual closed-diagonal deformation geometry. Every ordinary dualizing-to-Tate isomorphism e satisfying P.DiagonalOrientationNormalization satisfies the full diagonal/Rees/integration equation OrientationNormalized for G. No arbitrary coefficient ring or exceptional reduction comparison occurs.

proof.text: Construct the normalized section comparison by existsUnique_normalized and construct the cone-to-bundle pullback square from the canonical Rees and symmetric-cone comparisons. Apply the fixed-witness diagonal Rees equation to obtain the OrientationNormalized existential.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(2), witness construction and final Rees equation

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalOrdinaryReesNormalization (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (hP : P.extension = ⊥)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f]
    [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated aY] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (G : Etale.FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d
      (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.diagonal f))
    (e : Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) f ≅
      P.diagonalTwistEtale X d)
    (he : P.DiagonalOrientationNormalization d f aY e) :
    Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.OrientationNormalized P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.diagonalExponent_annihilates
      f d G (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit (f ≫ aY)) e
